name: ARIA-X
description: Python engine borrowing ARTEX, Cairn and PentAGI designs; console on 8787 and its own ARIA-X user agent on every request
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

indicators.context: Default ARTEX console port ARIA-X's console listens on 8787 too (01NGVI-QINGYI/ARIA-X config.py:135). Clearwing's sourcehunt webhook binds 0.0.0.0:8787 by default (Lazarus-AI-OSS/clearwing).
indicators.source: Censys

indicators.context: AI model API. Investigate only when a server calls it unexpectedly alongside other activity
Official Kali image HackSynth pulls for its attackbox, run with NET_ADMIN, SYS_PTRACE and /dev/net/tun (docker_setup.py:20-32). Used by many tools and people: context only
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the HackSynth source code

indicators.context: User agent ARIA-X v0.3.0 sends on every request of its http_request and web_probe tools, and on its DuckDuckGo research searches. Built from __version__, so other versions differ only in the number; the model can replace it through the tool's headers argument
